requested_sequence: Enable PPK2 at existing 5000 mV setting
Measure DUT_VIO, helper 3V3 and GP28 relative to common GND
Remove probes and take fresh 10-second average current
precision: As supplied; 0.0 V is a reported display reading, not proof of zero leakage
host_state: Capture service stopped; no live UART or ADC telemetry while helper USB disconnected
interpretation: No observable rise on helper 3V3 or GP28 at reported meter resolution with DUT_VIO present. Does not establish loaded isolation, transient behavior or complete power-order/board acceptance.
